name: Gradient Descent
source:
What makes love real? 

In a world where AI lives alongside Anthrokind, Stryker finds himself stuck in a situation against all odds. Torn between his identity and feelings, he must decide for himself what matters most.

[From [url=https://yaonam.itch.io/gradient-descent]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
究竟是什么让爱变得真实？

在一个AI与兽人族共同生活的世界里，斯特赖克发现自己陷入了看似毫无胜算的困境。在自身身份与内心情感的拉扯之间，他必须亲自抉择什么才是最重要的事物。

[摘自[url=https://yaonam.itch.io/gradient-descent]itch.io[/url]]
